name: Remove post-Marlin activation and normalization materializations
source_model_term: Marlin projections plus adjacent non-Marlin pointwise launches
hypothesis: A W4 projection that emits directly into its activation or normalization consumer can save launch and intermediate traffic even when the standalone GEMM is not faster.
derivation: The ceiling is limited to a small fraction of the 2.773 ms all-backbone-Marlin contribution because mathematical dependencies prevent eliminating the projection itself and earlier BF16 fusion attempts transferred poorly end to end.

evidence.claim: Current-schedule Marlin and non-Marlin component times.
